name: Amazon Textract
mechanism: Extracts printed and handwritten text plus forms, tables, queries and signatures through AWS-managed synchronous or asynchronous document APIs.
use_when: AWS workloads need forms, tables, signatures or queried fields
Managed typed extraction is more valuable than general document Markdown
avoid_when: Scientific formulas, charts or narrative hierarchy dominate
Documents cannot be processed by the managed AWS service
expected_effects: Typed form and table extraction in AWS
Signature and query features reduce custom detection code
failure_modes: Key-value relationships fail on novel forms
Async quotas or regional outages delay jobs
